name: nova-station
description: NOVA STATION — a production-grade browser-based 3D Web3 space station metaverse.

scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @nova/server build && pnpm --filter @nova/web build
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @nova/game-data build && pnpm --filter @nova/game-engine build && pnpm --filter @nova/shared build && pnpm --filter @nova/web3 build && pnpm --filter @nova/ui build
scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @nova/server dev" "pnpm --filter @nova/web dev"
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @nova/game-data test && pnpm --filter @nova/game-engine test && pnpm --filter @nova/shared test && pnpm --filter @nova/web3 test && pnpm --filter @nova/server test && pnpm --filter @nova/web test
